title: Spa Energy Usage kWh Used Leaderboard
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:energy kwh_used=*
| stats sum(kwh_used) as total_value, avg(kwh_used) as avg_value by spa_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks spa values by total and average kwh used across spa energy usage events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `kwh_used` values for each spa energy usage event and review total and average kwh used by spa.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total kwh used.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which spa shows the biggest kwh used numbers in your spa energy usage data.
